The bug was in the hooks-installed `shouldComponentUpdate` bail-out in `hooks/src/index.js:243`: when a component's state hooks all end up back at their original values (e.g. `setActive(true); setActive(false)` on one tick), the SCU returned `false` and discarded the render even when the parent had passed new props.

The fix mirrors upstream PR preactjs/preact#3739: also continue the update when the incoming props differ from the committed props (`boundComponent.props !== nextProps`), so parent-initiated prop changes are no longer swallowed by the state-equality optimization.

Validation:
- `hooks/test/browser/useState.test.js` "respects updates initiated from the parent" (FAIL_TO_PASS) fails on baseline, passes with the fix.
- Full hooks suite: 111 tests pass.
- Core browser suite: 386 pass (one pre-existing flaky `*Capture` focus failure exists on the unmodified baseline too).
- `npm run test:mocha` and eslint pass.
